notes.title: FREE PRESENT COSMETIC! EXPLOSIVE HARSH WINTER UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1][b]A limited time free present cosmetic is available in Everything Explosive's shop. Mix and Match it with your character.
[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Santa is here, and Harsh Winter came with him. The map is covered with snow, ice, and Glacier Guardians. These foes are ordinary snowmen that will become monsters when disturbed. Available in Battle Royale and Capture the Frag.[/b][/h3]

[b]NEW WEAPON: FROSTED LAUNCHER[/b]

A Rocket that turns into ice. If an opponent is hit by the ice, they will freeze temporarily. Available in shard shops.

[b]NEW COSMETICS:[/b] 

[list]

[/list]
[list]
[*] Glacier Guardian
[/list]

[*] Jolly Ol' Santa
[/list]
[list]
[*] Jolly Ol' Hat
[/list]

[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]

[/list]
[list]

[/list]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: BIGGEST UPDATE OF SEASON 1! EVERYTHING EXPLOSIVE RAMPAGE UPDATE
notes.notes:

[h3][b]An unidentified group of delinquents have blown up the bank. Explore multiple brand new locations, and show who is the most OP![/b][/h3]

[b]CHANGES[/b]

[list]
[*] OVERPOWERED LTM: Powerups fall from the sky and land on the middle island. Combined can show how OP you are against your opponents. Buffed Health and special abilities on OP items.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Shambles updated. Visit it to unlock the first page of the story!
[/list]
[list]

[/list]

[/list]
[list]

[/list]

[/list]

[/list]
[list]

[/list]
[list]

[b]Next update will be the HallowEEn update! Bugs that are reported will be fixed in this update. At the moment, the RAMPAGE UPDATE is the biggest update of Season 1, but this new update will be much, much larger of an update.[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE YOUR GAME SO YOU CAN SEE THE LIVE EVENT ON AUGUST 15TH, 3 PM ET!
notes.notes:
In order for you to have the viewing experience, you must have an updated game beforehand. To be sure your game is up to date, your lobby should look like this after logging in. The News should be the same, too. If you don't see these, please restart steam.
